title: Spectral line width
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the half-width ε of the Fabry-Perot transmission peak using the given formula with the provided reflectivity.

title: Etalon resolution
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the resolving power λ/Δλ of the etalon for the given parameters.

title: Refractive index of air
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the refractive index of air from the observed 10-fringe shift when pressure changes from vacuum to atmospheric.

title: Zeeman line frequencies
description: Important: Correctly expresses the frequencies of the four Zeeman-split lines (a, b, c, d) in terms of v₀, ΔE₁, and ΔE₂.

title: Energy gaps from diameters
description: Important: Correctly relates the measured fringe diameters to the energy gaps ΔE₁ and ΔE₂ using the small-angle interference condition.

title: Lande factor calculation
description: Important: Correctly calculates the Landé factors g_k1 and g_k2 from the given diameters, magnetic field, and fundamental constants.

title: Solar magnetic field
description: Important: Correctly calculates the solar magnetic field from the observed total wavelength splitting of the D1 line.

title: LED transmission analysis
description: Important: Correctly determines the number of transmitted lines and the frequency width of each line for the LED source incident on the etalon.

title: Sign error in Zeeman shifts
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns signs to the frequency shifts for lines a, b, c, d, or confuses the ordering of ΔE₁ and ΔE₂.

title: Diameter-squared relationship
description: Pitfall: Uses fringe diameters linearly instead of their squares when relating to wavelength or energy shifts.
